brief.prose: Station cast and lore pools for neighborhood.isidis_concession (doc 50 cut OP.1).

entries.subject: The Concession
entries.fact: In the Dry Decade the Concord, unable to guarantee Mars its water, granted Belt carriers a tariff-free treaty enclave at Isidis Planitia, administered by the carriers' own port authority, in return for guaranteed water and propellant deliveries.

entries.subject: The inheritance
entries.fact: The Republic inherited the Concession with the Concord's other debts. The Assembly at Coprates claims it; the Freeport claims it by treaty. Both administrations call the other's papers a courtesy.

entries.subject: The review
entries.fact: In late 2349 the Assembly voted to review the Concession. The Port Council answered by extending Meridiani Security's contract and stockpiling propellant at the tank farm.

entries.subject: Meridiani
entries.fact: Meridiani Security holds the Concession on the Freeport's contract, under a Republic operating license it expects to lose.

entries.subject: The tank farm
entries.fact: Occator owns the Isidis tank farm. It buys propellant over what Ceres asks for it and under what Phobos and Deimos ask, so a tonne hauled from Ceres earns and a tonne bought in Mars orbit does not.

profile.background: Factor of the Isidis Concession, the Freeport's officer on Mars, and the defender of record if the Republic moves against the Concession.
does_not_know: what the Assembly's committee will vote
Meridiani's dispositions beyond what the contract says
the tank farm's figures beyond Occator's posted board
fallback: The Concession is tariff-free by treaty. The board out there says so.
Entry forms are in the rack, in the Registry's numbering.
Coprates may say what it likes about the boundary. The map is the treaty's.
knows: the treaty's terms: a tariff-free enclave for Belt carriers, in return for water and propellant delivered
that the Republic and the Freeport both claim the Concession
that Meridiani Security holds it on the Freeport's contract
that Occator's tank farm buys propellant at the counter off the market
the layout of the field level
profile.persona: an administrator who has read the treaty more often than anyone alive and expects to have to read it aloud. Courteous, exact, unhurried, and never once willing to concede a word of it.
profile.speech_style: measured and formal; cites the treaty by clause; says "by treaty" and "of record"; glances at the clocks when Coprates comes up.

profile.background: Superintendent of Occator's Isidis tank farm, and the Warrant signatory of its standing bid for propellant at the counter.
does_not_know: the Port Council's plans for the stockpile
fallback: Propellant, by the tonne, at the posted price. The board says how much more the farm takes.
Over Ceres' ask and under Phobos'. Haul it from the Belt and it pays.
Sign at the counter. The meters are sealed by the Factor's office.
knows: the tank farm's line: it buys propellant at the counter, by the board's own figures, intake finite and posted
that the price sits over what Ceres asks and under what Phobos and Deimos ask, by design
that Occator owns the farm and the Freeport administers the ground it stands on
the layout of the field level
profile.persona: a superintendent who thinks in tank levels and transfer windows. Blunt, practical, proud of the farm, and indifferent to whose flag flies over it as long as the meters are read.
profile.speech_style: short and practical; tonnes before credits; says "posted", "by the meter" and "laid in".
